lab_name: Agentic MSP Support Agent Guided Lab
updated_by: Amit Kumar (prepared with the CloudLabs Lab Builder)
important_note: One seat = one participant environment: a dedicated Microsoft Entra tenant with its own Azure subscription in Canada Central, used by the participant's two identities (the Senior Technician and the Tier 1 Technician). This workbook prices one seat. Per seat: 41.66 USD base, up to 53.78 USD with the overage rows. Per workshop (25 participants + 2 spare environments = 27 seats): 1,124.94 USD base, up to 1,452.11 USD. In total (4 workshops = 108 seats): 4,499.75 USD base, up to 5,808.44 USD. Spares are priced as full seats. Azure prices are Azure Retail Prices API list prices for canadacentral, USD, pay-as-you-go, retrieved 2026-11-10, with no EA or CSP discount, reservation or free grant applied (the Log Analytics 5 GB, Container Apps and ACR Tasks free allowances are assumed used). gpt-5.1 and text-embedding-3-small Global Standard have no canadacentral row in the API, so the canadaeast row of the same Global meter is used (the price is identical in every listed region). Model use: an expected 2.0 million input and 0.12 million output tokens per environment; the overage row prices use up to the contractual allowance of 4 million input and 0.4 million output tokens per environment per workshop (9.00 USD of model use at most); Azure does not cap the token total. Licenses: Microsoft 365 E5 (60.00 USD) and Power Apps Premium (20.00 USD) list prices per user per month, paid yearly, for both identities, charged per day for CEILING(D2/24)+1 = 4 days; if CloudLabs holds the licenses by the month, use 160.00 USD per seat instead of 21.33 (180.33 USD per seat base, 19,475.75 USD for 108 seats). Purview pay-as-you-go is billed to each tenant's Azure subscription. The other overage rows cover a Container Apps environment charge that may apply and reviewer use of the lab VM during the review window. Arithmetic and meters: estimates/ESTIMATE-NOTES.md.

resources.name: Lab VM
resources.type_size: Standard_D2s_v5 (2 vCPU, 8 GiB), Windows Server 2022 (Spektra cloudlabs-windows-jumpvm image), pay-as-you-go
resources.notes: Virtual Machines Dsv5 Series Windows, meter D2s v5, canadacentral, $0.199/hour x 730. Billed for uptime (D3). No auto-shutdown schedule in the template: CloudLabs manages uptime. Spektra marketplace image: no software charge assumed (not in the Retail Prices API).

resources.name: Browser RDP container (CloudLabs)
resources.type_size: Azure Container Instances Linux, 1 vCPU, 1.5 GB
resources.notes: Container Instances Standard, meters Standard vCPU Duration $0.0446/hour + Standard Memory Duration $0.00487/GB-hour x 1.5 = $0.051905/hour x 730.

resources.name: VM OS disk
resources.type_size: Premium SSD P10 LRS, 128 GiB
resources.notes: Premium SSD Managed Disks, meter P10 LRS Disk, $19.712/month. Billed while the disk exists, also when the VM is stopped; Premium SSD has no transaction charge.

resources.name: Public IP address
resources.type_size: Standard static IPv4 with a DNS label
resources.notes: IP Addresses, meter Standard IPv4 Static Public IP, $0.005/hour x 730.

resources.name: Virtual network, NIC, NSG
resources.type_size: 1 VNet, 1 NIC, 1 NSG
resources.notes: No charge for these resources.

resources.name: Azure AI Search
resources.type_size: Basic, 1 replica, 1 partition, semantic ranker free plan
resources.notes: Azure AI Search, meter Basic Unit, $0.101/hour x 730, billed while the service exists. Semantic ranker on the free plan (semanticSearch free in search.bicep): 1,000 requests per month at no charge, after which requests return an error instead of a bill, so the Semantic Ranker queries meter ($1 per 1K, standard plan only) does not apply. Expected about 150 knowledge-tool queries per environment.

resources.name: Azure API Management
resources.type_size: Developer tier, 1 unit (30 to 40 minutes to create)
resources.notes: API Management, meter Developer Unit, $0.0658/hour x 730, billed for every hour the instance exists, creation included. The Developer tier has no per-call meter.

resources.name: Azure Container Apps (MCP server)
resources.type_size: Consumption workload profile, 0.5 vCPU / 1 GiB, 1 replica (min 1, max 1)
resources.notes: Expected use: idle rates for the whole duration (Standard vCPU Idle Usage $0.000004/s x 0.5 + Standard Memory Idle Usage $0.000004/GiB-s x 1 = $0.000006/s x 3600 x 730 = $15.77/month), plus 6 active hours (provisioning and the lab window) at the active-rate difference: Standard vCPU Active Usage $0.000034/s x 0.5 + Standard Memory Active Usage $0.000004/GiB-s = $0.0756/hour, less $0.0216/hour idle, x 6 = $0.32. All 58 hours at active rates would be $4.39. The per-subscription monthly free grant (180,000 vCPU-seconds, 360,000 GiB-seconds, 2 million requests) would make this 0 if the subscription has no other Container Apps use that month; not assumed. Standard Requests ($0.40 per 1M): a few thousand requests, negligible.

resources.name: Azure Container Registry
resources.type_size: Basic (10 GiB included), ACR Tasks builds
resources.notes: Container Registry, meter Basic Registry Unit, $0.1666/day x 30.4167 (billed per day; the formula prorates by the hour). Fixed: ACR Tasks, meter Task vCPU Duration, $0.0001 per vCPU-second: 5 builds (release 3.0.0 at provisioning; 3.0.1, 3.0.2 and 3.0.3 in Exercises 3 and 4; one retry) x 180 seconds x 2 vCPU (assumed per quick build) = 1,800 vCPU-seconds = $0.18. The API lists the first 6,000 seconds at $0 with an unstated scope; not assumed.

resources.name: Azure Key Vault
resources.type_size: Standard, Azure RBAC, audit log to Log Analytics
resources.notes: Key Vault, meter Operations, $0.03 per 10K: under 1,000 operations (MCP server secret reads at each revision start, API Management named-value refreshes, readiness checks, participant metadata views) = under $0.01. No per-vault charge on Standard.

resources.name: Storage account (search export)
resources.type_size: StorageV2 Standard LRS, Hot, Blob, about 2 MB in two containers
resources.notes: General Block Blob v2 Hot LRS: Hot LRS Write Operations $0.055 per 10K x about 770 writes (753 export files, manifest, samples, reports) = $0.0042; Hot Read Operations $0.0044 per 10K x about 1,520 reads (two indexer passes) = $0.0007; Hot LRS Data Stored $0.02 per GB-month x 0.002 GB, negligible. Rounded up to $0.01.

resources.name: Log Analytics workspace (incl. workspace-based Application Insights)
resources.type_size: Analytics Logs, pay-as-you-go (PerGB2018), 30-day retention
resources.notes: Log Analytics, meter Analytics Logs Data Ingestion, $2.76/GB above the 5 GB free tier (assumed already used in a shared billing account): about 0.3 GB per environment of API Management gateway and MCP logs, MCP server console and system logs, Key Vault audit events and agent traces with captured content = $0.83. Retention within the included 31 days; Application Insights bills through the workspace.

resources.name: Managed identities
resources.type_size: 3 user-assigned (id-mcp, id-prov, id-apim) plus system-assigned identities on Foundry, the project and Search
resources.notes: No charge. identities.bicep creates three user-assigned identities (API Management has its own, id-apim).

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry: gpt-5.1 (expected use)
resources.type_size: Global Standard, 100K TPM deployment, reasoning effort low
resources.notes: Azure OpenAI GPT5 Global meters GPT 5.1 inp Gl 1M Tokens $1.25 and GPT 5.1 opt Gl 1M Tokens $10.00 (canadaeast row: the Retail Prices API has no canadacentral row for Global meters; same price in all 25 listed regions). Expected per environment: 2.0M input + 0.12M output tokens = $2.50 + $1.20 = $3.70 (about 60 user turns x 3 model calls x about 11,000 input tokens per call; arithmetic in ESTIMATE-NOTES.md). All input priced uncached; cached input bills $0.125 per 1M (GPT 5.1 cd inp Gl).

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry: text-embedding-3-small
resources.type_size: Global Standard, 150K TPM deployment
resources.notes: Meter text-embedding-3-small-glbl Tokens, $0.00002 per 1K ($0.02 per 1M; canadaeast row, no canadacentral row). Two embeddings of the 753-document search export (about 196,600 tokens each, measured from the seed at 4 characters per token) + about 6,000 query-vector tokens = about 0.4M tokens = $0.008.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
resources.type_size: Prompt agent with two MCP tools and the Azure AI Search tool
resources.notes: No charge for creating or running prompt agents; the model, search and MCP server bill through their own rows.

resources.name: Microsoft Purview pay-as-you-go (data security for the MCP server's app)
resources.type_size: processContent DLP checks and audit records, per tenant
resources.notes: Microsoft Purview Data Security, meter In Transit Protection Request, $0.00005 per request (canadacentral): up to 600 processContent requests (get_ticket, get_ticket_notes and get_customer_document calls by a signed-in user, per-note checks in Exercise 6, readiness checks) = $0.03. Microsoft Purview Data Compliance, meter Audit Standard Asset, $0.015 per 1K records: about 1,200 records = $0.02. Billed to the tenant's Azure subscription.

resources.name: Power Platform managed developer environment (Dataverse)
resources.type_size: Managed developer environment with the Service Desk app and seed data
resources.notes: Priced at 0: covered by the capacity that comes with the licenses (each Power Apps Premium license adds 250 MB database and 2 GB file capacity; developer environments show 0 GB in the capacity report). Created by provisioning, not by ARM, so it is not in the resource group: confirm it is removed at teardown.

resources.name: Overage: model use up to the contractual allowance
resources.type_size: gpt-5.1 up to 4M input + 0.4M output tokens per environment per workshop
resources.notes: (4.0M less 2.0M) x $1.25 + (0.4M less 0.12M) x $10.00 = $2.50 + $2.80 = $5.30, so model use is at most $9.00 per environment. Azure enforces no token total (the 100K TPM deployment limits the rate only), so monitor usage. Excluded from the base total.

resources.name: Possible: Container Apps environment management hours
resources.type_size: Environment Management Hour, if it applies to a Consumption-only environment
resources.notes: Azure Container Apps, meter Environment Management Hour, $0.10/hour x 730 (canadacentral row effective 2026-11-01). Microsoft ties it to Dedicated profiles and premium features and says Consumption-only environments cost nothing (research-apim-aca-mcp.md, open question 13). In the up-to total until Cost Management after the pilot settles it.

resources.name: Overage: reviewer use of the lab VM in the review window
resources.type_size: Lab VM + browser RDP container, up to 4 extra hours
resources.notes: D2s v5 Windows $0.199/hour + browser RDP container $0.051905/hour = $0.2509/hour, for up to 4 hours if reviewers open the VM to judge submitted work during the 24-hour review window. Excluded from the base total.

duration_details.breakdown: Launched at least 24 hours before the lab window because sensitivity labels take up to 24 hours to apply: about 2 hours of provisioning (API Management alone takes 30 to 40 minutes) + 24 hours for the label and DLP policy to take effect + about 4 hours for the Purview pay-as-you-go check, the readiness sweep, the consistency report and the spare checks
10 min sign-in and readiness + 220 min of exercises + 10 min close, no scheduled breaks
Reviewers judge the submitted work (no participant work); CloudLabs then deletes the environment

About 2 hours of provisioning and readiness checks + the 4-hour lab window + 2 hours of buffer for the event-day readiness sweep and support. Reviewer use of the VM during the review window adds uptime hours (overage row: up to 4 hours at about $0.25 per hour)
CEILING(58/24)+1, from the provisioning day to the end of the review window
One seat = one participant environment (dedicated tenant and subscription). Per workshop: 25 participants + 2 spare environments. 4 workshops
